comparisonScope: Same camera-compiled runner, fixture, two-sample 128-path workload, immutable RNG prefix and whole-round scheduling. Balanced AB/BA pairs compare only the guard.
limitations: No separately compiled historical anchor setup comparison. Shared setup is excluded from renderer pairs and reported separately.
Four unchanged representative fixture identities at the historical 128-path workload; no large-workload or physical-GPU performance claim.
Every warmup and measurement receives the unchanged raw shadow gate, analytic power, exact RNG and replay ownership checks, plus zero audit-discovered replacements.
Renderer wall time includes native dispatch/wait, readbacks and selective CPU replay; full CPU shadow construction and audit/admission are separate. These are host wall times, not GPU timestamps.
Software timings are descriptive and sensitive to compiler/cache/scheduler effects; eight pairs are not statistical evidence of general speedup.
